models_evaluated: Three published CNN models for head and neck cancer outcome prediction
New proposed CNN with fewer parameters

links.outcome: Whether published CNN studies reported the details needed to reproduce results
links.effect: All three studies failed to report elements needed for reproduction, mainly image pre-processing steps and the random seed.
links.quote: All three studies failed to report elements required to reproduce their results thoroughly, mainly the image pre-processing steps and the random seed.

unlisted_practices: Assessing the impact of image pre-processing choices and model selection criteria on CNN prognostic performance

screen.reason: The study empirically investigates the reproducibility of published CNN prognostic models in head and neck cancer imaging and tests the impact of preprocessing decisions, but it evaluates model technical development/benchmarking rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
